investigator.method: Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC (curl, descriptive User-Agent, no authentication/JS) against the task-given official events URL, which returned HTTP 404; Level 2 STRUCTURAL against the site's own publicly-referenced sitemap.xml -> event-pages-sitemap.xml, which enumerates every current event-details/<slug> page, each independently confirmed (by a further Level 1-style plain GET) to embed a full schema.org Event JSON-LD block.

probe_history.reason: A plain curl GET of the task-given official events URL (https://www.truskel.fr/copie-de-concerts-4, labelled 'Live') returned HTTP 404 Not Found — a Wix 'classic-error-pages-statics' page, confirming the task's own suspicion that this path is stale. A further plain curl GET of the site's own homepage (https://www.truskel.fr/) succeeded (HTTP 200) and embeds a Wix Events widget script plus two JSON-LD blocks (LocalBusiness/WebSite, not Event), and exposes only a handful of static <a href> links to individual event-details/<slug> pages directly in the HTML (e.g. flores-wales-blitzdolls, indie-rock-night, melasse-interruption, uk-is-ok) plus a link to /event-list — enough to prove per-event pages exist and are statically linked, but not enough on its own to enumerate the venue's full current schedule.

Fetched the site's own root sitemap.xml (a Wix-generated, publicly-referenced structural endpoint), which points to event-pages-sitemap.xml — a complete, current listing of every live event-details/<slug> URL with a lastmod date, going well beyond the handful of links exposed on the homepage alone. Fetching two of those event-details pages directly (flores-wales-blitzdolls, vision-peripherique-aleas) confirmed each independently embeds one full schema.org Event JSON-LD block (name/startDate+endDate with an explicit +02:00 UTC offset/location name+address/image) — fully answering both 'how do we enumerate the schedule' and 'how do we get structured per-event data' without any further escalation.

identity.notes: Every retained event-details page's own JSON-LD 'location' object directly states name 'TRUSKEL' and address '12 Rue Feydeau, 75002 Paris, France' — an exact match to the task-given address — at the venue's own domain truskel.fr (the task's given .fr domain, confirmed live and current; truskel.com was not probed and is out of scope). The <title> of each page reads '... | Le Truskel'.

site_classification.platform: Wix (confirmed via response headers — 'x-wix-request-id', 'server: cloudflare' fronting Wix, static.parastorage.com/static.wixstatic.com asset hosts — and the Wix 'classic-error-pages-statics' 404 page template). Each individual event-details/<slug> page (not a single bulk list page) embeds its own single schema.org Event JSON-LD block; the venue's full current schedule is enumerated via the site's own Wix-generated sitemap.xml, not a bulk JSON-LD array.

title.notes: Each event-details page's own JSON-LD 'name' field, stated directly.

start_date.notes: Each event-details page's own JSON-LD 'startDate', a full ISO 8601 instant with explicit +02:00 UTC offset (e.g. '2026-08-27T19:00:00+02:00'), stated directly.

time.notes: The same JSON-LD 'startDate' string carries an explicit numeric UTC offset (+02:00) — a confirmed UTC instant, not a floating local guess.

end.notes: Each event-details page's own JSON-LD 'endDate' is a full ISO 8601 instant with the same explicit offset, directly stated — unlike Tempodrom Berlin's own 'endDate' (which encoded only a calendar day for multi-day runs), this source's endDate consistently carries a full same-day end time on every sampled record, matching a genuine performance-end reading.

venue_location.notes: Each event-details page's own JSON-LD 'location.name'/'location.address', stated directly and identically across both sampled records.

source_record_id.notes: No numeric ID is exposed on the Event object itself; each event's own JSON-LD 'location.url' (and the page's own canonical URL) is this source's own permanent '/event-details/{slug}/' path — the site's own stable permalink slug is used as source_record_id, the same documented judgement already established for moog-barcelona-01/LAV and tempodrom-berlin-01.

event_url.notes: Each event-details page's own JSON-LD 'location.url', stated directly (schema.org places the Event's own canonical URL on the nested Place object on this source, not on the Event node itself — used as event_url since it is the page's own permanent address).

price.notes: Neither sampled JSON-LD Event node includes an 'offers'/price field of any kind; no price text was found elsewhere on the retained excerpts either.

reasons: Identity PROVEN from a self-consistent retained artifact (page titles, each JSON-LD's own location.name/address matching the task-given address exactly).
acquisition_class JSON_LD_EVENT, a resolved supported class, reached via Level 1 (INSUFFICIENT, task-given URL stale) then Level 2 (SUFFICIENT, sitemap enumeration + per-event JSON-LD).
CONFIRMED public data paths retained: the sitemap enumeration path plus at least one per-event JSON-LD page.
title, start_date, time, end, venue_location, source_record_id, event_url all PROVEN with basis DIRECT_SOURCE across two independently-sampled event pages.

recommended_family JSON_LD, this project's own existing, fully generic, already-proven collector family (ingestion/json-ld/parse.mjs + observation-adapter.mjs) — extractEventNodes()/normaliseJsonLdEvent() already handle a single-Event-node page exactly as well as a bulk array; only a small new per-venue discovery step (fetch sitemap.xml -> event-pages-sitemap.xml -> enumerate event-details URLs -> fetch each) is genuinely new, kept in a bespoke ingestion/truskel-paris/discovery.mjs rather than touching the shared json-ld family.

DETERMINISTIC_DERIVATION offline-proof evidence now retained (tests/truskel-paris.test.mjs, re-parsing the two retained fixtures via the existing json-ld family) — this investigation is therefore READY_FOR_OFFLINE_PROOF; READY_FOR_ACTIVATION is a separate, later, explicitly-authorised step outside this investigation's scope.

One honest caveat: the task-given events URL (truskel.fr/copie-de-concerts-4) is confirmed stale (404) as of this investigation — any future activation must configure events_url as the sitemap-driven discovery path, not that stale URL.
